requirements.text: RELAUNCH THE CODEX LOOP ON THE CAMPAIGN — the proven supervisor-bridge loop (limited-auto dispatch + live Codex/Astra reviews through the bridge, 'the guide') is relaunched on the D-045 campaign queue per the documented relaunch mechanics, and does the full production job (research, build, in-loop review, rework) shift after shift. The build session stops conducting waves by hand once the loop is live.
requirements.required_harness: loop live on campaign tasks; dispatch/review records show the bridge lanes active
requirements.required_evidence: loop-produced campaign tasks moving through the normal lifecycle

requirements.text: AUTHORITY BOUNDARY UNCHANGED — this directive does NOT activate live automated acceptance/merging: the R595 live-actuation path stays unbuilt/shadow; final acceptance stamps, merges, pushes of record, and all ledger/git/gh authority remain with the monitoring orchestrator session (ADR-005/ADR-006). The loop produces and reviews; the monitor stamps. 'Final pushing and final monitoring stay off to the side' per the owner's design.
requirements.required_harness: no auto-accept/auto-merge events; acceptance records carry the monitor's authority
requirements.required_evidence: ledger/gate records; absence of supervisor-actuated accepts

requirements.text: COMMUNICATION MODEL (answers the different-PowerShell question) — the detached loop communicates only through the repository: commits/pushes, the ledger, and the queue files. The MONITORING session (build session in quiet-watch mode) is the bridge to the owner: it surfaces major breaks only (standing quiet rule) PLUS owner-addressed research requests and return items per D-050-R005 (push notifications + seam lines), since the detached process has no owner-facing channel. Owner->loop direction flows through the monitor (or the companion -> monitor relay): directives, research answers, and holds are injected by the monitor under its authority, never by editing the loop's internals mid-flight.
requirements.required_harness: monitor surfaces breaks + owner items; queue file current on the pushed branch throughout loop operation

requirements.text: ASTRA'S TWO ROLES STAY DISTINCT — (a) the in-loop Codex reviewer lane ('the guide') resumes as built with the relaunch; (b) the owner-side Astra deep-research channel (D-050) is UNCHANGED: owner-driven, manual, non-blocking; the loop appends research requests to docs/RESEARCH_REQUESTS.md via its normal commits and the monitor notifies the owner. Neither role substitutes for the other, and neither is a source of record or a sign-off. All campaign directives D-045..D-052 bind inside the loop exactly as outside it; D-047 producer-model intent applies within the loop's owner-approved model allowlist (a blocked allowlist is an owner settings item, never a bypass).
requirements.required_harness: bridge review records; D-050 queue mechanics functioning under loop operation

requirements.text: RELAY / EXECUTION (return item) — the companion relays this directive to the build session; the build session verifies the capture, executes the documented relaunch mechanics (certified manifest binding, ask-store handling, worktree bases, watcher posture — its own recorded traps), and reports the loop-live state plus the monitoring posture at its next owner-facing seam. Discharged when the loop is live on campaign tasks with the monitor in quiet-watch.
requirements.required_harness: cross-session message + acknowledgment; relaunch executed; seam report
requirements.required_evidence: message in this capture's audit_log; loop-live evidence at the seam
